about.title: About RideHub
about.subtitle: Redefining premium mobility since 2010.
about.storyP1: Founded in San Francisco, RideHub began with a simple vision: to create a destination where enthusiasts and professionals could experience the world's finest bicycles, electric scooters, and motorcycles under one roof.
about.storyP2: Today, we partner with over 24 leading brands and showcase more than 180 vehicles, serving clients across North America and Europe with unmatched expertise and passion.
about.mission: To inspire and enable exceptional mobility experiences through curated premium vehicles, expert guidance, and a commitment to sustainable innovation.
about.vision: To be the global benchmark for premium mobility showcase — where design, technology, and human experience converge.
about.partnersSubtitle: We collaborate with the world's most respected mobility brands.
about.locationSubtitle: Experience our collection in person at our flagship location.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products and services.
faq.q1: What types of vehicles does RideHub showcase?
faq.a1: RideHub showcases premium bicycles, electric scooters, and electric motorcycles from world-leading brands including Trek, Giant, Specialized, Segway, Xiaomi, and Zero Motorcycles.
faq.q2: Can I test ride a vehicle before purchasing?
faq.a2: Yes! Our flagship showroom offers scheduled test rides for most vehicles in our collection. Contact our team to book your personalized experience.
faq.q3: Do you offer electric and non-electric options?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Our catalog includes traditional performance bicycles alongside cutting-edge electric bikes, scooters, and motorcycles to suit every preference.
faq.q4: How do I check product availability?
faq.a4: Each product page displays current availability status. For real-time updates, contact our sales team directly via phone, email, or the contact form.
faq.a5: Yes, pre-orders are available for select upcoming models. Submit a request through the product page or contact form to secure your reservation.
faq.a6: Warranty terms vary by brand and product category. All vehicles include manufacturer warranty, and we provide extended coverage options for added peace of mind.
faq.q7: Do you offer service and maintenance?
faq.a7: Our certified technicians provide comprehensive service and maintenance for all brands we represent, from routine tune-ups to complex repairs.
faq.q8: Do you handle fleet and business orders?
faq.a8: Yes, we specialize in fleet solutions for businesses, municipalities, and corporate clients. Contact our business team for customized proposals.
faq.q9: What are the minimum order quantities for business clients?
faq.a9: Minimum quantities vary by product and brand. We work with orders of all sizes and offer volume pricing for qualifying business accounts.
faq.q10: How can I get product specifications?
faq.a10: Detailed specifications are available on each product page. For technical datasheets or comparison guides, contact our support team.
faq.a11: We're open Monday through Friday 9 AM – 7 PM, Saturday 10 AM – 6 PM, and Sunday 11 AM – 5 PM. Holiday hours may vary.
faq.q12: How do I reach customer support?
faq.a12: Reach us by phone, email, WhatsApp, or through the contact form on our website. We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours.
